why_it_passes: An approval of a monthly cost: the agent does the upgrade itself with access it already has, and the card says what each choice costs and what it changes for clinics.

card.title: Pay $40 more a month for a bigger database?
card.context: Our database is 92% full and grows about 3% a week. When it fills up, clinics cannot save new notes until we make room. The hosting company's next size up costs $40 more a month ($65 to $105) and doubles the space. The agent that runs our hosting account can switch it in about five minutes with no downtime.
card.question: Should the agent move the database to the next size up, for $40 more a month?

choices.label: Yes, upgrade now
choices.pros: about a year of room; no risk of clinics being unable to save notes

choices.label: Not now; the agent clears out old chat logs instead
choices.cons: deleting chat logs older than two years (the only data we can drop) buys two or three weeks, then this question comes back

card.why: In under three weeks clinics could stop being able to save notes; $40 a month removes that risk for about a year. The agent switches it with access it already has; you only approve the cost.
